layout_spacing.philosophy: Generous Spacing (p-8 to p-24) with strict grid structures. Bento Grids for features.
layout_spacing.surface_treatment: Deep dark backgrounds with 1px border-white/10, NO heavy gradients unless it's a glowing 'tracing beam' for the pricing card.

hero.structure: Asymmetric layout. Left: High-impact typography + Waitlist Form. Right: 3D Smartphone Bot Mockup floating over Amber Shield.
hero.effects: Hero image needs a glowing radial gradient behind it. Max overlay opacity bg-black/50.

forward_to_check_demo.structure: Interactive Shadcn Form inside a Glassmorphism container. Input for URL, Button to 'Scan'. Result reveals SAFE/DANGER animation.
forward_to_check_demo.effects: Use Framer Motion for revealing the verdict. Danger verdict flashes red, Safe verdict pulses green.

threat_feed.style: Monospace typography, text-sm, red/green accents for 'BLOCKED' or 'PHISHING'.

pricing_card.structure: Central focus, 'Tracing Beam' animated border effect, solid CTA.

images.description: Cinematic abstract glowing electric amber and gold shield polygon
3D render of a dark sleek modern smartphone with chat interface
Abstract glowing neon green checkmark and secure lock
Abstract glowing crimson red warning hazard skull

interactions.hover_states: All buttons MUST explicitly define hover colors. Primary buttons: bg-[#FFB000] hover:bg-[#FFC133] text-black.
interactions.animations: Framer motion for staggered bento grid entrance. react-fast-marquee for threat feed.
interactions.testing: All interactive elements MUST have data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='waitlist-submit').

instructions_to_main_agent: Use pure HTML/Tailwind for structural layout (bento grid, hero).
Use Shadcn for Interactive elements (Accordion for FAQ, Input/Button for Waitlist & Scan demo).
Integrate Stripe Checkout for the pricing button ($4.99/mo).
Store Waitlist form submissions in MongoDB.
DO NOT use Inter or standard sans for headings. Use 'Unbounded' font for headings, 'Outfit' for body, and 'JetBrains Mono' for data/logs.
Implement the 'Forward to Check' demo as an actual functional UI component that takes an input and shows a simulated scanning state then a SAFE/DANGER result.
Use Lucide React for standard icons (Shield, Lock, AlertTriangle).
Follow 'Tracing Beam' surface strategy for the pricing card.
Ensure high contrast rules are respected as per design system.
